upstream.subject: fix: silentJSONParsing=false should throw on invalid JSON (#7253) (#7257)

surfaced.subject: Revert "fix: silentJSONParsing=false should throw on invalid JSON (#7253) (#7..." (#7298)
surfaced.description: The change dropped the `&& JSONRequested` qualifier from `strictJSONParsing`, so with silentJSONParsing:false axios threw on any non-JSON string body - plain text and HTML responses included - rather than only when the caller had actually asked for JSON. Reverted two days later.
